page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Below the last line, at the right, two small garbled marks (catchword and signature), which I could not read. No margin notes, page number or running head.

main_text.p: Trib. alij plurib. put error semper novus ex ore[?] gignitur, & multiplicatur maximé. Nam vno absurdo posito sequuntur multa, quod vulgo dici solet. Duo loca veritas ipsa defun-ctis tribuit, prout homines sese bene aut malé in vita gesserunt: locum vitæ bonis & benedi-ctis Dei, malis locum mortis. Atq; hic quidem locus quem mortis dicimus, non fuit vulgo propter varios pœnarum gradus in locadiver-sa distributus, quia communis est omni-um carcer, quamuis tormentis differen-tibus. Quapropter nec locum vitæ propter varios gradus gloriæ illius aut illius status animarum dividi in diversa quasi cochlea oportebat. Nam status communis vitæ stationē communem habet, quamuis gradib. inter se differentib. Aliud est domus sive statio, aliud status, aliud deniq; gradus in statu differēs. Abutuntur quidē multi verbis Christi dicētis Ioan. 14.2. in domo Patris mei mansiones multæ sunt: sed nihil aliud sibi Christus his verbis voluit, quam domū Patris multorum capacem esse. Alioquin si variæ mansiones intelligerentur à Christo ut gens Pontificia tradit de variis locis, pugnaret illud cum celeberrima illa & decantatissima veterum, & Pōtificiorum doctrina, qui Apostolis & martyrib. affirmant beatorum sedem esse statim à morte attributam,

page.notes: The large decorative initial at the top left is read as "Trib." and may be partly hidden. The word at the line end "ex e" (superscript mark) and the next line "ore" is uncertain; "ore[?]" is marked. The printed "s" long s has been written as plain s throughout. The u/v spelling was normalised in "novus", "sequuntur", "diversa", "dividi", "sive", "voluit", "variis" and "Apostolis". The small marks at the bottom right are illegible and were not transcribed as catchword or signature.
